meta.title: اختبار الفصل الأول في اللغة الإنجليزية (النموذج 3)
topics: the verb to be and have got

paper:
Hi! I'm Rania. I'm eleven years old and I'm from Blida. In my class, there are thirty-two pupils. My best friends are Walid and Sara. Walid is twelve. He has got a big brother and a little sister. Sara is from Annaba. She is very kind and she has got a beautiful cat. Our English teacher is Mrs Benali. She is nice and funny.

(Text written by the site)

Part One (14 points)

A. Reading comprehension (7 points)

1. True or false? a) Rania is twelve. b) There are thirty-two pupils in her class. c) Sara has got a cat.

2. Answer the questions: a) Where is Rania from? b) Who is the English teacher?

3. What do the underlined words refer to? "He" → … ; "She" → …

B. Mastery of language (7 points)

1. Complete with "am / is / are": I … a pupil. — Walid and Sara … my friends. — The teacher … nice.

2. Complete with "has got / have got": Walid … a brother. — We … a new classroom.

3. Write the numbers in letters: 11 → … ; 32 → …

4. Complete with "my / his / her": Sara has got a cat. … cat is beautiful.

Part Two (6 points)

Written expression

Introduce a classmate in 5 sentences: name, age, town, family, and something he/she has got.
